gpqa_thinking32_partial.note: R6000 32K thinking-on GPQA still running — 94/198 questions as of 2026-05-19T21:09

risks.description: GPQA thinking-off accuracy 0.374 is below the 0.41 floor. Mac users who disable thinking mode will get degraded GPQA-level performance. The PROMOTE_READY_FOR_MAC decision hinges on thinking-on 32K compensating — this is a conditional gate, not an unconditional pass.

GPQA thinking-on 32K data is live partial (94/198). If the remaining 104 questions degrade significantly, the ex-parse-fail accuracy could drop below the 0.80 gate threshold. Re-check when R6000 finishes the full 198-question run.

NVFP4 TPS 62.5 tok/s is 60% below the 155 tok/s promotion threshold. This is a fundamental bandwidth limitation of the current FP4 repack path on R6000. The native FP4 tensor-core pipeline (P191→P192→P193) must deliver >=155 tok/s to unblock NVIDIA promotion.

Structured content gate (P196) used a 70-prompt hard set where W4A16 itself only passes 90%. The absolute quality floor is not 100% — there are 7 known hard failure classes. This is acceptable for relative gating but means structured output is not bulletproof on any variant.
